hooks.prompt: A file was just written by the Write tool. Hook input JSON: $ARGUMENTS. Look at tool_input.file_path. If it does not match docs/<filename>.md (a direct child of the /docs directory), do nothing and stop. Otherwise: 1) Read CLAUDE.md in the project root. 2) Under the '## ALWAYS check `/docs` first' section there is a bullet list of documentation files (each line like "- `docs/xyz.md` — description.") ending right before the sentence starting with "If no doc covers". If a bullet already references docs/<filename>.md, do nothing and stop. 3) Otherwise read the new doc file itself and write a new bullet in the exact same style as the existing bullets (backtick-wrapped path, em dash, one concise sentence summarizing what the doc covers), and insert it as the last item of that bullet list, preserving a blank line between the list and the 'If no doc covers' sentence. 4) Do not modify any other part of CLAUDE.md.
